per_question.question: What does Fusion 360 do?
per_question.answer:
Fusion 360 is a cloud-based 3D modeling, CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB software platform for product design and manufacturing. [Source: Document 3, Document 5] It’s a computer-aided engineering (CAE) tool that includes simulation, stress analysis, thermal analysis, and fluid flow analysis. [Source: Document 1] 

It’s designed for both consumer and professional use, combining design, simulation, collaboration, and machining in a single package. [Source: Document 2, Document 3] It allows teams to work together seamlessly on projects, reducing time to market. [Source: Document 4] 

You can find more details on Autodesk’s website: [Web: https://www.autodesk.com/solutions/what-is-fusion-360]
